QUESTIONS

Anything else on your mind?

Feeling stuck? Don’t worry! Our team is here to help and will respond within one business day. We’re committed to your support!

Do I need technical skills to use AERITH?

No. Workflows are built on a visual canvas, and you can describe what you want in plain language while the assistant assembles the steps. Teams typically publish their first automation within an hour.

How long does setup take?

Connect your first tool and you are running in minutes. Most teams start with a single template — lead routing, ticket triage, or invoice approval — and expand from there.

Is my data used to train models?

Never. Your workspace data stays inside your workspace, is encrypted in transit and at rest, and is excluded from any model training.

What happens when a workflow fails?

The run stops at the failing step, keeps its full context, and notifies the owner. You can retry a single step without re-running the whole workflow.

Can I change plans later?

Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from billing settings. Changes are prorated to the day.

Do you offer support during onboarding?

Every plan includes documentation and email support. Growth adds priority response, and Scale includes a dedicated success manager and migration help.
